originalTitle: Watch: Madonna and Taylor Swift win big at the MTV VMAs
summary: Taylor Swift, Madonna, and LISA were among the big winners at the MTV Video Music Awards (VMAs) on Sunday evening in downtown Los Angeles.
content:
Taylor Swift, Madonna, and LISA were among the big winners at the MTV Video Music Awards (VMAs) on Sunday evening in downtown Los Angeles.

Madonna performed at the awards show for the first time in more than 20 years, and took home a handful of awards including artist of the year.

Meanwhile, Taylor Swift was awarded the first-ever Artist Director Honor and also scooped the night's top award, video of the year.
chineseTitle: 观看：麦当娜和泰勒·斯威夫特在 MTV VMA 上大获全胜
chineseSummary: 泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift)、麦当娜 (Madonna) 和丽莎 (LISA) 成为周日晚上在洛杉矶市中心举行的 MTV 音乐录影带大奖 (VMA) 的大赢家。
chineseContent:
泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift)、麦当娜 (Madonna) 和丽莎 (LISA) 成为周日晚上在洛杉矶市中心举行的 MTV 音乐录影带大奖 (VMA) 的大赢家。

麦当娜二十多年来首次在颁奖典礼上表演，并获得了包括年度艺术家在内的多项奖项。

与此同时，泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 获得了首个艺术总监荣誉奖，并获得了当晚的最高奖项——年度最佳视频奖。
